summary: Final acceptance gate for Phase 1 (Cluster A — malformed JSDoc remediation + recurrence guard). All FRs in scope are satisfied: FR-1 (4 enumerated malformed @returns rewritten in d26ecd52); FR-2 (144 working-tree files discarded via git restore in 0006074f, corrected generator template committed in b3cf07e6, restored-files.txt manifest preserved); FR-3 (balanced-brace guard committed in e195fded, hardened in e992abbf to scan the full remainder of each line for stray { after the balanced type region). All 4 prior audits (review-a, review-b, review-c, phase-acceptance) returned status=pass with empty *_violations arrays. Adversarial testing exposed one bypass (embedded {} in prose, scenario adv-03) which was closed in the same commit (e992abbf); all 10 adversarial scenarios now pass, and all 4 original fixtures (3 malformed + 1 clean) still produce expected exit codes. Live verification this audit: (a) production-scope FR-3 guard on apps/ packages/ convex/ → 2237 files / 663 typed tags / 0 violations / exit 0; (b) adversarial runner → 10/10 pass / exit 0; (c) adv-03 fixture re-run → STRAY_BLOCK, exit 1 (bypass closed); (d) per-file guard on each of the 6 modified source files → 0 violations; (e) git grep -nP '@returns \{.+ \{\}' and '@param \{[^{}]*$' over apps/ packages/ convex/ → 0 matches each; (f) git diff e195fded..HEAD --stat over apps/ packages/ convex/ → 6 files, 6 insertions(+), 6 deletions(-), all JSDoc-only single-line edits; (g) working tree on apps/ packages/ convex/ is empty; (h) the only TS error in scope (review-queue/index.tsx:45 TS2769) confirmed pre-existing at baseline e195fded (out of Phase 1 scope per test-strategy §2 and tech-debt). Commit chain matches plan + adversarial fix exactly: e195fded → d26ecd52 → 5ebf5195 → 0006074f → b3cf07e6 → 0aa18a77 → bd3ac8f5 → e992abbf. The 2 @param fixes (StrugglingStudentsPanel.tsx, review-queue/index.tsx) beyond FR-1's enumerated 4 are a justified, documented scope extension caught by the FR-3 guard — exactly the recurrence-guard behaviour the spec mandates. No spec drift, no FR silently widened/narrowed/skipped, no parity/grep/spy oracles introduced. Ready for closeout.

nonblocking_findings.description: FR-2 step C (re-run the JSDoc generator across the 144 files and verify zero violations before committing) was substituted with a discard-and-template approach because no JSDoc generator script is checked in (the batch was agent-driven). Justified and documented in _artifacts/generator-investigation.md and plan.md §FR-2 step C. Recurrence-prevention goal is satisfied by the corrected template (templates/jsdoc-template.md) plus the FR-3 guard (0 violations across production scope). Carried from phase-acceptance.json NB-1 and review-a.json NB-1.

FR-3 guard is not yet wired into CI (lefthook / pre-commit / GH Actions). Out of Phase 1 scope per test-strategy §1; captured as a follow-on in generator-investigation.md and review-b.json. Acceptable for closeout — the guard is executable and is invoked by the closeout artifact regeneration path.

Strategy's Red baseline anticipated 4 FR-1 violations; the FR-3 guard caught 2 additional @param cases at HEAD (StrugglingStudentsPanel.tsx, review-queue/index.tsx) introduced by spec-compliance Phase 3 (a5c2d410) and missed by the typed-params guard. Fixed in 5ebf5195. This is a discovery beyond spec — the spirit of FR-1 + FR-3 (no malformed annotations at HEAD) is satisfied by fixing all 6. Not drift. Carried from phase-acceptance.json NB-3.

No lessons-learned.md entry was added in Phase 1 for the JSDoc generator anti-pattern (the bug class itself). FR-20 (document the test-integrity / anti-pattern standard in lessons-learned) is explicitly scheduled for Phase 7. Recommend folding the generator prompt invariant — the FR-3 syntactic-invariant approach and the prose-stray-brace bypass adversarial finding — into that Phase 7 entry. Carried from review-a.json NB-2.
